ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The diagram is a potential-energy-versus-reaction-coordinate graph. The y-axis is labeled “Potential Energy” and the x-axis is labeled “Reaction Coordinate.” The curve begins at the reactants level, rises over an activation-energy peak, then drops to the products level. The products are drawn at a lower vertical position than the reactants. Reasoning: On a potential energy diagram, lower vertical position means lower energy. Since the products have lower potential energy than the reactants, energy is released overall. Therefore, the reaction is exothermic, with reactants at a higher energy level than products.
